services.title: Everything you need to get online and grow.
services.label: What we do

items.title: Custom Websites
items.description: From landing pages to full business sites. Built with React & Next.js — mobile-first, fast by default, and designed to convert.

items.title: Website Redesigns
items.description: Already have a site that's underperforming? We rebuild it with modern tech, better SEO, and faster load times.

items.title: SEO & Performance
items.description: Technical SEO foundations, Core Web Vitals tuning, and content strategy to get you found on Google.

items.title: Ongoing Support
items.description: Monthly retainers for hosting, updates, security patches, and performance monitoring. We keep it running so you don't have to.

items.question: How long does a typical project take?
items.answer: Most websites are delivered within 4–8 weeks depending on scope. We'll give you an honest timeline during the discovery call.

items.question: What is your pricing model?
items.answer: Fixed-price quotes before we start. No scope creep surprises, no hidden fees. You know the cost upfront.

items.question: Do I own the code?
items.answer: Yes, 100%. Full source code, documentation, and hosting freedom. No lock-in, ever. If we part ways, you keep everything.

items.question: Do you offer ongoing support?
items.answer: Yes — monthly retainers for hosting, updates, security patches, and performance monitoring. Or we hand everything over and you run it yourself.

items.question: How do we get started?
items.answer: Book a free 30-minute discovery call. No pressure, no jargon — just an honest conversation about what you need.

cta.heading: Ready to start a project?
cta.subtext: Book a free discovery call and let's talk about what you need.
